from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout
        title = "The Invariant Property: The Balancing Act"
        lines = [
            "Watch the stars on one side of the line.",
            "As the line rotates, stars stay on their side.",
            "During a hand-off, the count remains the same.",
            "This invariant property is the key to the proof.",
            "No matter the pivot, the balance never changes."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)

        # 2. Colors & Config
        ORANGE_COLOR = "#FFA500"
        LASER_COLOR = YELLOW
        STAR_COLOR = WHITE

        # 3. Mobjects Creation
        # Star positions based on 6x6 grid (visuals in Row B-E, Col 2-5 to avoid lecture and clipping)
        # Pivot A: C3, Pivot B: B4
        # Left Stars: B2, D2
        # Right Star: C5
        star_a = Star(color=STAR_COLOR, n_reentrant_points=5).scale(0.15)
        star_b = Star(color=STAR_COLOR, n_reentrant_points=5).scale(0.15)
        star_l1 = Star(color=STAR_COLOR, n_reentrant_points=5).scale(0.15)
        star_l2 = Star(color=STAR_COLOR, n_reentrant_points=5).scale(0.15)
        star_r1 = Star(color=STAR_COLOR, n_reentrant_points=5).scale(0.15)

        self.place_at_grid(star_a, "C3")
        self.place_at_grid(star_b, "B4")
        self.place_at_grid(star_l1, "B2")
        self.place_at_grid(star_l2, "D2")
        self.place_at_grid(star_r1, "C5")
        
        stars = VGroup(star_a, star_b, star_l1, star_l2, star_r1)
        
        # Labels (Placed within 1 grid unit of targets as per L003)
        label_a = Text("A", font_size=18).next_to(star_a, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        label_b = Text("B", font_size=18).next_to(star_b, UP, buff=0.1)

        # Counter (Positioned at B5, top-right area of visuals)
        counter_label = Text("Stars on Left: ", font_size=20)
        counter_val = Integer(2, font_size=20)
        counter_group = VGroup(counter_label, counter_val).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        self.place_at_grid(counter_group, "B5")

        # Laser Line setup
        line_length = 6
        angle_tracker = ValueTracker(0) # Clockwise rotation from vertical (90 degrees relative to X)
        pivot_pos = [star_a.get_center()] # Container to allow updater to access dynamic pivot

        # Initialize laser
        laser = Line(
            pivot_pos[0] + UP * line_length/2,
            pivot_pos[0] + DOWN * line_length/2,
            color=LASER_COLOR,
            stroke_width=3
        )

        # Updater for efficient continuous rotation and pivot shifting (L010)
        def update_laser(m):
            angle = angle_tracker.get_value()
            direction = rotate_vector(UP, angle)
            center = pivot_pos[0]
            m.set_points_by_ends(
                center - direction * line_length/2,
                center + direction * line_length/2
            )

        laser.add_updater(update_laser)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # "Watch the stars on one side of the line."
        self.lecture[0].set_color(ORANGE_COLOR)
        self.play(
            FadeIn(stars), 
            FadeIn(label_a), 
            FadeIn(label_b),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.play(Create(laser), run_time=1)
        # Highlight orange stars and show counter
        self.play(
            star_l1.animate.set_color(ORANGE_COLOR),
            star_l2.animate.set_color(ORANGE_COLOR),
            FadeIn(counter_group),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # "As the line rotates, stars stay on their side."
        self.lecture[1].set_color(ORANGE_COLOR)
        # Rotate from vertical (0) to pass through B (-PI/4, given AB vector is (1,1))
        self.play(angle_tracker.animate.set_value(-PI/4), run_time=3)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # "During a hand-off, the count remains the same."
        self.lecture[2].set_color(ORANGE_COLOR)
        # Seamlessly shift pivot to Star B while at the same geometric position
        pivot_pos[0] = star_b.get_center()
        # Highlight counter and the set of orange stars
        self.play(
            Indicate(counter_group),
            Indicate(star_l1, color=ORANGE_COLOR),
            Indicate(star_l2, color=ORANGE_COLOR),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # "This invariant property is the key to the proof."
        self.lecture[3].set_color(ORANGE_COLOR)
        # Emphasize the invariant stars using Indicate (L004)
        self.play(Indicate(star_l1, color=ORANGE_COLOR), Indicate(star_l2, color=ORANGE_COLOR))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # "No matter the pivot, the balance never changes."
        self.lecture[4].set_color(ORANGE_COLOR)
        # Continue rotation around the new pivot B
        self.play(angle_tracker.animate.increment_value(-PI/3), run_time=3)
        self.wait(2)
